title: the Glass Steppe Rising Anew
author: Theo Okafor
blurb: Quentin Underhill, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
